items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: It was Billy Morero, I guess he was manager, wasn't he? ... He was playing bass with the Superior.

ctx.x: Which is it. I think it looks good, but it doesn't get to be a band of the right support. No musician can't appreciate it.

There's somebody out there that knows what it's all about, they think he's racing sand, you know what I mean? Yeah. But I know better than you know better. See? And I tell him, he wouldn't tell me he didn't want to do it, but I can see his attitude, he become indignant, you know, about that. He's going, I'll catch it, I'll catch it, just go, I don't want that. If I'm rehearsing a band, let a man play like a talent, if I go ahead and play he'll catch it. You know what I'm telling me Bill? That's why I've never had…
